summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a Management Information Circular for its August 7, 2026 annual general meeting. The filing mentions a Plan of Arrangement entered on January 26, 2026 with Zijin Gold International Company Limited, but no deal terms (price, premium, close date) are disclosed. The circular is routine annual meeting material; the transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and has not closed. The meeting will be cancelled if the transaction closes beforehand. No forced management change or special-situation event is triggered by this filing alone.
